''Starac (The Old Man)'' | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1945|06|16}} | ground = [[Bilino Polje Stadium]], [[Zenica]] | capacity = 13,694 | chairman = Denis Mušović | manager = [[Bojan Regoje]] | league = [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Premier League BH]] | season = [[2025–26 First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|2025–26]] | position = [[First League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina|First League of FBiH]], 1st of 14 (promoted) | website = {{URL|http://www.nkcelik.ba/}} | pattern_la1 = _macronsceptrum22rb | pattern_b1 = _macronsceptrum22rb | pattern_ra1 = _macronsceptrum22rb | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 000000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = 000000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = FF0000 | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _macronrodders1br | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 }} '''Nogometni klub Čelik Zenica''' ({{langx|en| Football Club Čelik Zenica}}) is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Zenica]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. The name ''Čelik'' means ''Steel'' in [[Bosnian language|Bosnian]], and it symbolizes the strength and power of the club in an industrial city well known for steel production. Throughout its history, the club has been known for the excellent support of its fans at its [[Bilino Polje Stadium]], which hosts the [[Bosnia and Herzegovina national football team|Bosnia and Herzegovina national team]]. NK Čelik is one of the most prominent and successful football teams in Bosnia and Herzegovina, being one of only two Bosnian clubs to win the national championship three consecutive seasons (1994 to 1997). The club also won consecutive national cups in 1995 and 1996. During the time of the former Yugoslavia, Čelik had played 17 seasons in the [[Yugoslav First League]]. Čelik won the [[Mitropa Cup]] two times and was once a joint winner of the [[UEFA Intertoto Cup]]. In addition, Čelik is the only [[List of fan-owned sports teams|fan-owned football club]] in Bosnia and Herzegovina where club members democratically elect its leadership.{{Cite web|url=https://www.aa.com.tr/ba/sport/usvojen-novi-statut-nk-%C4%8Delik-na-principu-jedan-%C4%8Dlan-jedan-glas/721257|title=Usvojen novi statut NK Čelik na principu "jedan član-jedan glas"|website=www.aa.com.tr|accessdate=24 April 2023|archive-date=23 October 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231023204910/https://www.aa.com.tr/ba/sport/usvojen-novi-statut-nk-%C4%8Delik-na-principu-jedan-%C4%8Dlan-jedan-glas/721257|url-status=live}} Today, the club is active in the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]]."}}
